Reflecture Symbol Set v2.0
A Renderable, Codified Language of Sacred Form
Aligned to RCS v1.0 and Designed for Systemic Implementation

Core Principles
	•	All symbols must be symbolically meaningful, visually distinct, and computationally renderable
	•	Each symbol includes: a name, glyph representation, meaning, rendering method, and usage constraints
	•	Symbols should be expressible through vector geometry, polar logic, or transformable sequences

Symbol Definitions
● Node Point
	•	Meaning: Center of presence or emergence
	•	Render: Filled circle at coordinate point (cx, cy)
	•	Constraint: Must align to grid junction or radial origin
{
  "type": "node",
  "position": [x, y],
  "style": "solid",
  "size": "standard"
}
— Trace Line
	•	Meaning: Flow, signal, action, connection
	•	Render: Straight line between two valid coordinates
	•	Constraint: Must begin or end at a node or other primitive
{
  "type": "trace",
  "start": [x1, y1],
  "end": [x2, y2],
  "style": "solid"
}
∠ Refractive Angle
	•	Meaning: Shift in intention, perception, or phase
	•	Render: Two trace segments connected at angle ≤120°
	•	Constraint: Must connect two directional traces; angle rule enforced
{
  "type": "refraction",
  "joint": [x, y],
  "entry_vector": [vx1, vy1],
  "exit_vector": [vx2, vy2],
  "angle_degrees": 60
}
∅ Null Field
	•	Meaning: Silence, absence, sacred void
	•	Render: Empty circle (not filled), drawn at defined center and radius
	•	Constraint: Must relate to trace, node, or loop context (no floating)
{
  "type": "null",
  "center": [x, y],
  "radius": 0.3,
  "style": "outline"
}
◯ Loopback Circuit
	•	Meaning: Recursion, memory, return, holding
	•	Render: Circle drawn around node, trace junction, or pair
	•	Constraint: Must enclose ≥1 valid element; may be full or partial arc
{
  "type": "loopback",
  "center": [x, y],
  "radius": 1.0,
  "encloses": ["node"],
  "style": "solid"
}
≈ Attenuation Curve (updated from ~~~)
	•	Meaning: Dissipating energy, fading influence, trailing resonance
	•	Render: Parametric sine wave or dashed modulated arc
	•	Constraint: Must flow outward from source
{
  "type": "attenuation",
  "origin": [x, y],
  "direction": "radians",
  "length": 1.2,
  "amplitude": 0.08,
  "frequency": 10,
  "style": "dashed"
}
◎ Echo Node
	•	Meaning: Historical resonance, asynchronous contact
	•	Render: Small faded circle with dotted trail from parent
	•	Constraint: Trail must connect to source
{
  "type": "echo",
  "origin": [x, y],
  "offset_angle": 0.35,
  "distance": 1.5,
  "opacity": 0.6,
  "style": "dotted"
}
═══ Ground Bar
	•	Meaning: Structural stability, foundation, field anchoring
	•	Render: Two or more parallel horizontal lines
	•	Constraint: Must bisect or underlie node or radial axis
{
  "type": "ground",
  "span": [[x1, y1], [x2, y2]],
  "offset": 0.05,
  "style": "double-line"
}

Reserved Symbols (Optional / Future)
	•	⊕ Polarity Node — to represent bi-directional resonance or choice
	•	↻ Rotation Marker — to imply cycle, loop tension
	•	▦ Grid Mark — for schematic overlays or alignment snap points
